user.title: PitUp
user.description: Open PitUp → Settings → Home Assistant → “Generate token” and paste the token here.

reauth_confirm.title: PitUp: new token
reauth_confirm.description: The PitUp token no longer works (it was regenerated or the account changed). Generate a new one in PitUp → Settings → Home Assistant and paste it here.

error.plan_limit: Integrations are not included in your PitUp plan.

init.title: PitUp notifications
init.description: Native Home Assistant app pushes for new due/overdue items (maintenance and insurance). Enter your notify service, e.g. mobile_app_your_phone. Empty = disabled.
